items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: I bought a small edition of Shakespear's works... had to look up all the words to find out what they meant.

ctx.x: That's right. And I bought a small edition of Shakespear's works. Those small pocket things used to carry them in my suitcase. And my dictionary, had to look up all the words to find out what they meant. And I would read those and I would read philosophy.
Do you have any idea of how many years you continued to do this?
